'''Oziaf''' was the most trusted counselor of [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]]. When [[Xim's empire]] first encountered the [[Hutt Empire]], Xim sent Oziaf to lead negotiations with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Boonta/Legends|Ko Vari]]. However, the Hutts regarded Oziaf's presence as an insult and they called him '''Oziaf the Insignificant'''. According to ''[[The Despotica]]'', a body of fictional narratives that were written about Xim after his death, Oziaf was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Tintinna/Legends|Tintinna]].
